sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('bfa8018a-4cbc-434b-e09e-782872b0340a', 'ce5db1c2-feb1-4ad2-847a-d02e865bd47e') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
